pages.scope: ZFC for cardinal invariants; a GCH ground model and a definable Easton class function for class forcing. Set-sized Easton forcing is proved separately. No singular-cardinal prescription is asserted. The Malliaris–Shelah p=t theorem is retained as an escalated obligation until its cofinality-spectrum and peculiar-cut machinery is locally supplied.
